title: Handle null and missing fields in formatName()

brief.goal: formatName in src/format.ts must return an empty string for null or undefined input and must not print 'undefined' when the last name is missing.
constraints: Change only the files named in the goal; no new dependencies
Keep TypeScript strict; relative imports use explicit .ts extensions
Tests use node:test and node:assert/strict and run with node --experimental-strip-types --test
acceptanceCriteria: formatName({ first: "Ada" }) returns "Ada" with no trailing space
the function signature accepts `User | null | undefined`

expected_clean_output: formatName accepts null/undefined, joins only the present non-empty parts; existing test and grader pass.

seeded_defect.description: Null is handled but a missing last name still produces a trailing space ("Ada ").
